en.html: 首領"You were adopted into the Minato family, and this Hikaru girl is the child who actually carries the bloodline? Then… were the two of you assigned as a pairpartners by decree?"
en.text: 首領"You were adopted into the Minato family, and this Hikaru girl is the child who actually carries the bloodline? Then… were the two of you assigned as a pairpartners by decree?"

ja.html: 首領 「あなたは湊斗家に養子入りした人間で、光 って娘の方が血統を継ぐ本当の子供なの？ 　なら……もしかしてあなた達、許婚いいなずけ？」
ja.text:
首領
「あなたは湊斗家に養子入りした人間で、光
って娘の方が血統を継ぐ本当の子供なの？
　なら……もしかしてあなた達、許婚いいなずけ？」
